postings.title: Billing Specialist
postings.text:
At Qualia, we've built the leading B2B real estate technology that transforms the home buying and selling experience into a simple, secure, and enjoyable process. Our SMB and Enterprise products bring together users from across the real estate ecosystem---homebuyers and sellers, lenders, title and escrow agents, and real estate agents---onto a single shared digital closing platform, providing greater clarity and transparency to real estate transactions. Today, through our business customers across the country, millions of consumers use Qualia to close on homes every year.

WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON

Qualia's billing environment is complex. We manage subscription billing, usage-based charges, marketplace transactions, multiple credit structures, and a wide range of payment terms across thousands of customers. This role sits at the center of it all. As a Billing Specialist on the Revenue Operations team, you'll own and run core billing operations — processing payments, resolving billing discrepancies, generating invoices, managing credits, and ensuring our customers are billed accurately and on time. You'll work closely with Deal Desk, Finance, Customer Success, Growth Management, and Engineering to maintain data integrity across the full quote-to-cash lifecycle. This is not a back-office role. You are the point person for billing-related questions from customer-facing teams, and the quality of your work directly impacts customer trust, revenue recognition, and Qualia's ability to grow.

RESPONSIBILITIES

• Day-to-day billing operations: Oversee the billing status of accounts by researching and resolving billing inconsistencies, errors, and edge cases. Process incoming payments, manage billing runs, and ensure invoices are generated accurately — including for customers on non-standard payment plans, split payments, and deferred terms

• Invoicing and customer billing materials: Create invoices and custom billing materials for Strategic and High Growth accounts. Review customer payment plans regularly for timely payments and follow up where necessary

• Credits and adjustments: Manage the application of bank partner credits, ORT credits, and Qualia credits to customer accounts. Investigate and resolve situations where credits have not been applied correctly, and ensure visibility for customer-facing teams into credit balances and application history

• Refunds and concessions: Manage the approval process for concessions and refunds. Issue refunds, collect on failed charges, and review payment disputes in accordance with established approval thresholds

• Collections and past-due account management: Own the collections process for overdue accounts, including direct outreach to customers via email and phone. Navigate sensitive payment conversations with professionalism and empathy, working to resolve outstanding balances while preserving strong customer relationships and escalating to Growth Management or Customer Success when needed

• Cross-functional collaboration: Serve as the primary point of contact for billing-related support cases from Growth Managers, Customer Success Managers, and Support. Participate in daily billing standups and biweekly case reviews to identify patterns, reduce repeat inquiries, and surface systemic issues

• Data quality: Monitor billing data for errors such as duplicate subscriptions, incorrect plan amounts, overstated allotments, and misconfigured charges. Proactively flag issues before they reach customers rather than waiting for inbound reports

YOUR BACKGROUND THAT LIKELY MAKES YOU A MATCH

• 1–2 years of experience in billing operations, accounts receivable, or a revenue operations role — ideally in a SaaS or subscription-based environment

• Experience with subscription billing platforms (Ordway, Zuora, Chargebee, or similar) and familiarity with how billing systems integrate with CRMs and ERPs

• Strong command of Excel and Google Sheets; comfortable working with large datasets to investigate discrepancies and build reports

• High attention to detail and a low tolerance for unresolved loose ends — you follow issues through to completion

• Strong verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to explain complex billing situations clearly to both internal teams and customers

• Ability to work well with ambiguity, prioritize across competing requests, and problem-solve independently in a fast-paced environment

• Comfort navigating cross-functional relationships — you'll work daily with Deal Desk, Finance, Engineering, and customer-facing teams

Nice to Have:

• Experience with Salesforce, Intacct, Ordway, or Stripe

• Familiarity with revenue recognition concepts (ASC 606) and how billing data feeds into accounting processes

• Experience with collections or dunning processes

• Background in real estate, fintech, or title & escrow

Based in Austin, TX, with the ability to work in the office a minimum of two days per week is required.

WHY QUALIA

Qualia is made up of incredibly bright, mission-driven coworkers who are passionate about using technology to solve real-world problems---and we're growing quickly. In order to continue building an engaging and dynamic organization, we're committed to giving everyone the support they need to do great work.

Our benefits package is designed to allow our team members to be their best selves, both in and out of the workplace. In addition to comprehensive health plans, a 401k program, and commuter benefits, we prioritize family and personal well-being through professional development, parental leave, and a flexible time off policy. Qualia offers a robust online onboarding program to train new hires, biweekly all hands meetings, and a variety of internal virtual events to keep employees connected.

We believe diverse perspectives and backgrounds are critical to building great technology, and our goal is to cultivate an environment where people feel equally valued and respected. Qualia is proud to be an equal-opportunity workplace, and we welcome applicants from all backgrounds regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, marital status, age, citizenship, socioeconomic status, disability, or veteran status.

By submitting your application, you acknowledge and agree to the collection, processing, and use of your personal information as described in our Employee Data Privacy Notice.

postings.title: Senior Finance Manager, FP&A
postings.text:
At Qualia, we've built the leading B2B real estate technology that transforms the home buying and selling experience into a simple, secure, and enjoyable process. Our SMB and Enterprise products bring together users from across the real estate ecosystem---homebuyers and sellers, lenders, title and escrow agents, and real estate agents---onto a single shared digital closing platform, providing greater clarity and transparency to real estate transactions. Today, through our business customers across the country, millions of consumers use Qualia to close on homes every year.

WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON

The FP&A team at Qualia is the analytical engine of the Finance organization. We own the company's planning and forecasting processes, serve as trusted business partners to functional leaders, and produce the financial insights that inform our most important strategic decisions, all in an environment where AI is actively reshaping how we work.

As a Senior Manager of FP&A, you will be a central force in shaping how Qualia plans, forecasts, and makes decisions as we scale. You will own high-impact analytical workstreams end-to-end, serve as the go-to financial partner for senior functional leaders, and help set the direction for how the FP&A function evolves, from the models we build to the processes we run to the way we leverage AI to work smarter. This is a high-visibility individual contributor role with direct exposure to executive and C-level audiences.

RESPONSIBILITIES

• Own Qualia's planning and forecasting infrastructure: Lead the design, build, and continuous improvement of our operating model, annual plan, and long-range financial plan, ensuring they accurately reflect the current and future state of the business

• Drive financial rigor at the executive level: Lead preparation of monthly and quarterly management reporting, Board materials, and investor-facing financial packages; distill complex financial results into clear narratives that drive action at the leadership level

• Be the senior financial voice for key business units: Serve as a strategic thought partner to VP and C-level leaders across some key functions throughout Qualia; proactively surface insights, flag risks, and bring independent analytical judgment to the most consequential decisions

• Lead high-impact ad hoc analysis: Own complex, cross-functional analytical projects including M&A support, fundraising preparation, scenario planning, and strategic initiative evaluation from end to end

• Architect scalable FP&A processes and automation: Identify and eliminate structural inefficiencies in how we plan, report, and analyze; build AI-powered workflows and automation that meaningfully reduce manual effort and improve the quality and speed of financial insights

• Set the analytical standard: Establish best practices for financial modeling, data quality, and insight communication across the FP&A function; be the person others look to for how financial work should be done

YOUR BACKGROUND THAT LIKELY MAKES YOU A MATCH

• 7+ years of experience in FP&A, Corporate Finance, or Strategic Finance at a high-growth technology company or experience in Investment Banking or Consulting, with a demonstrated track record of increasing scope and ownership over time

• Deep financial modeling expertise - able to architect complex, multi-driver models from scratch, pressure-test assumptions, and communicate analytical conclusions with conviction to executive audiences

• SaaS business model fluency - strong command of SaaS metrics (ARR, NDR, GDR, CAC, LTV, cohort analysis) and the ability to connect operational drivers to financial outcomes across a multi-product, multi-revenue-stream business

• Executive-level communication - proven ability to distill nuanced financial analysis into crisp, actionable narratives for C-suite and Board audiences; equally effective in writing and in the room

• Strategic business partner - experienced working directly with VP and C-level leaders, earning trust through sound judgment, intellectual honesty, and a point of view, not just analysis

• Owner mentality - comfortable taking full end-to-end ownership of complex, ambiguous workstreams with minimal direction; you define the problem as much as you solve it

• AI-forward - actively uses AI tools (e.g., Claude, Gemini) to automate workflows, accelerate analysis, and build more scalable financial infrastructure; both experimenting, and ultimately operationalizing

Based in San Francisco, CA, with the ability to work in the office a minimum of two days per week is required.

This role has a base annual salary of $175,000-$210,000 plus a competitive equity and benefits package. (Salary to be determined by relevant experience, location, knowledge, and skills of the applicant, internal equity, and alignment with market data.)

WHY QUALIA

Qualia is made up of incredibly bright, mission-driven coworkers who are passionate about using technology to solve real-world problems---and we're growing quickly. In order to continue building an engaging and dynamic organization, we're committed to giving everyone the support they need to do great work.

Our benefits package is designed to allow our team members to be their best selves, both in and out of the workplace. In addition to comprehensive health plans, a 401k program, and commuter benefits, we prioritize family and personal well-being through professional development, parental leave, and a flexible time off policy. Qualia offers a robust online onboarding program to train new hires, biweekly all hands meetings, and a variety of internal virtual events to keep employees connected.

We believe diverse perspectives and backgrounds are critical to building great technology, and our goal is to cultivate an environment where people feel equally valued and respected. postings.title: Technical Accounting and Special Projects Manager
locations: Austin, TX or San Francisco, CA
postings.text:
At Qualia, we've built the leading B2B real estate technology that transforms the home buying and selling experience into a simple, secure, and enjoyable process. Our SMB and Enterprise products bring together users from across the real estate ecosystem—homebuyers and sellers, lenders, title and escrow agents, and real estate agents—onto a single shared digital closing platform, providing greater clarity and transparency to real estate transactions. Today, through our business customers across the country, millions of consumers use Qualia to close on homes every year.

WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON

Qualia's accounting function sits at the center of a fast-growing SaaS business navigating complex revenue arrangements, evolving GAAP guidance, and M&A activity. This role owns the technical accounting, financial reporting, and provides deal support from due diligence through post-close integration. The role is also instrumental in supporting operational accounting.

You'll work closely with Business Development, Legal, Tax, FP&A, and the Controller to make sure technical conclusions are sound, documented, and reflected correctly in the financials.

This role reports to the Controller.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Technical Accounting and Reporting

• Research and document complex accounting matters under U.S. GAAP

• Draft and maintain technical accounting memos and accounting policy documentation

• Own financial statements including footnote disclosures

• Serve as key contributor in annual financial statement audits

• Advise on complex accounting topics, including revenue recognition, equity transactions, debt modifications, business combinations, consolidation, and impairment analyses

• Monitor emerging accounting standards and assess applicability to the company

• Lead the resolution of complex technical corporate accounting matters across the monthly and quarterly close

• Assist the Accounting Team in implementing processes needed to support technical conclusions, e.g. proper journal entries, reconciliations, clear ownership, and effective controls

• Anticipate emerging accounting standards, shape accounting policy and change-management efforts, and translate new guidance into practical implementation strategies, financial statement disclosures, reporting calendars, and scalable reporting processes

Special Projects

• Lead purchase accounting activities under ASC 805, including valuation coordination, opening balance sheet review, and transaction accounting. Prepare related technical accounting memoranda supporting transaction-related conclusions

• Explore/support accounting policy changes that may benefit the company

• Participate in process improvements across accounting operations

• Lead ad hoc projects as needed

Operational Accounting Support

• Support the monthly closes, eg financial reviews, variance analysis

• Assist with complex account reconciliations

• Assist revenue team in ensuring compliance with ASC 606

• Assist in reviewing non-standard, complex customer contracts and associated outcomes in automated systems

YOUR BACKGROUND THAT LIKELY MAKES YOU A MATCH

• 5+ years of relevant accounting experience and CPA are required

• Big 4 public accounting or equivalent national firm experience is required

• Previous consulting, audit, or industry experience with SaaS, fintech, or payments companies is required

• Technical knowledge and hands-on experience with ASC 606 is required

• Working knowledge of ASC 805 (purchase accounting) is required

• Proven track record of researching complex accounting matters, drafting technical accounting documentation, and advising leadership on accounting implications

• Comfort with ambiguity, adaptability to dynamic priorities, and ability to lead ad-hoc special projects outside standard accounting responsibilities

• AI-forward: Actively uses AI tools (e.g., Claude, Gemini) to accelerate documentation, testing, and evidence workflows; both experimenting, and ultimately operationalizing

Based in San Francisco, CA or Austin, TX, with the ability to work in the office a minimum of two days per week is required.

This role has a base annual salary of $130,000–$185,000 plus a competitive equity and benefits package. (Salary to be determined by relevant experience, location, knowledge, and skills of the applicant, internal equity, and alignment with market data).
